key_insight: Factorial testing identified HVOF settings yielding acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide attributes for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings provide a process-development starting point: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Evaluate four spray parameters at two levels using a reported 24-run full factorial design.
Measure coating quality and use ANOVA to quantify parameter contributions.
Use Pareto analysis to assess parameter interaction effects.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports coating-response measurements across 24 experimental runs but provides no numerical quality results or statistical effect sizes.
watch_item: Validate the settings for the intended equipment and application; the abstract does not establish performance outside the tested conditions.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
